text: As of mid-2025, the RIF has committed $771.2 million, with $397.3 million approved and $30.1 million disbursed. The flood resilience stream has earmarked $101 million for 42 projects under the 'Before the Deluge' portfolio, with councils contributing around 40% of project costs. The initiative is in its early execution phase, focusing on consolidating and delivering flood resilience projects.
